newsitem.title: USA: Cygne Q1 hurt by sourcing unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Cygne Q1 hurt by sourcing unit sale.

text.p: Cygne Designs Inc said Friday the $76.1 million decrease in its first quarter sales was primarily due to a $60.6 milllion decrease in sales to AnnTaylor Stores Corp.

Cygne, which sold its AnnTaylor sourcing operations to AnnTaylor in September 1996, reported a first quarter loss of $0.37 per share on net sales of $7.6 million, compared to a profit of nil per share on sales of $83.8 million a year earlier.

Cygne said sales were also hurt by discontinued customer and product lines that generated sales of $9.5 million in the first quarter of last year, offset in part by increases in sales to other customers.
Sales to Limited Inc divisions fell by $7.0 million, and Cygne anticipates sales to Limited will continue to decrease.

The company also said license agreements entered into last summer with Kenzo Group in North America were terminated, and Kenzo will return $400,000 in pre-paid royalty payments and pay Cygne for raw materials related to the manufacture of Kenzo products.
Cygne said it continues to review its operations and expects to incur additional costs for further restructuring and downsizing.
